name: net.mail7/email-validation
title: Mail7 Email Validation
description: Verify email addresses, clean lists, and audit a domain SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX setup.

environmentVariables.name: MAIL7_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Mail7 API key. Optional, but anonymous callers are limited to 5 checks per minute and a 25-address bulk sample. Get one at https://mail7.net/account/

environmentVariables.name: MAIL7_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API endpoint. Defaults to https://mail7.net/api
